customManagers.description: Container images pinned in role defaults (<name>_image: registry/repo:tag)
Beszel agent binary version (downloaded from GitHub releases, not a container)

immich_version is shared by the server and ML images. Driven by the ML image's -openvino tags, so only versions with a published OpenVINO ML image are proposed. IM-AC-01 in CI checks the server and ML tags at the same version.
forgejo_runner job images pinned by digest (tag@sha256)

hostRules.description: codeberg.org's registry paginates tag lists and sits behind several backends; unthrottled lookups intermittently came back incomplete, so Renovate autoclosed the Forgejo PR and reopened it on the next run. Serialise and slow the requests, and allow a longer timeout.

packageRules.description: Minor/patch image bumps: grouped, auto-merged once CI passes
Never auto-bump major versions (opens a PR only)

Forgejo: stay on the LTS series. 15.x is supported until 2027-07-15; 16.0 is non-LTS and reaches end of life on 2026-10-29. The only allowed tag is the one already pinned, so no PR is opened until this rule is changed to the next LTS major (see https://forgejo.org/releases/).
Postgres: minor/patch only, no major upgrades (needs a dump/restore)
Immich's DB image is pinned to a matching vectorchord/pgvectors combo
Pocket ID (auth provider): upgrade manually after reading release notes
Caddy upgrades skipped for now (incl. the locally built caddy-cloudflare image)
